title: Who
lyrics: [E]How you gonna reckon with a God like this?
[B]When you gonna face what you can't dismiss?
[E]Whatcha gonna say to the soul kiss that [B]is my God?
[E]Fearsome like the sag in a fat man's chair.
[B]Sweeter than a patch of Rogaine hair.
[E]How do you define what you can't compare?
And there's [D]no use explaining what [D/F#]can't be con[G]tained.
[C]I'm not following a [G]God I can lead around;
[E]How you gonna reckon with a God this great?
[B]Why you gonna measure what you can't equate?
[E]Whatcha gonna say to the checkmate that [B]is my God?
[E]Stronger than the burn of an aftershave.
[B]Tender as a burger in your microwave.
[E]Rarer than the air in an empty grave.
We'd end up worshipping a [F]Christ of our [G]own de[C/E]sign.
